name: Camden Property Trust

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Camden Property Trust logo.png, 534x187 px)

description: Camden owns, operates, develops and acquires apartment communities across the Sunbelt and Washington DC: 175 properties with 59,921 apartment homes at Dec 31, 2025 (172 operating, 3 under construction with 1,162 homes). Income is monthly apartment rent plus other fees; no single property is over 1.5% of revenue. Same-store communities (54,625 homes) are 92% of property revenue. Largest metros are Houston, Dallas/Fort Worth, Washington DC, Atlanta and Orlando.
